steps.title: Research and plan implementation
steps.description:
Analyze the requirements and plan the React notes app implementation. Tasks:
1. Review the full requirements from PROMPT.md
2. Plan the component structure (App, NoteList, NoteForm, NoteItem)
3. Design the data model for notes (id, title, body, timestamp)
4. Plan localStorage integration strategy
5. Sketch out the TypeScript interfaces needed
6. Identify the key React hooks to use (useState for notes, useEffect for localStorage sync)
7. Plan basic CSS structure for clean minimal styling
8. Document the file structure (src/App.tsx, src/components/, src/types.ts, etc.)
9. Verify Vite + React + TypeScript setup requirements
10. Create a brief implementation plan for the worker agents to follow

steps.title: Initialize Vite project with React and TypeScript
steps.description:
Set up the project scaffolding using Vite. Tasks:
1. Run 'npm create vite@latest' with React + TypeScript template
2. Navigate to the project directory
3. Run 'npm install' to install dependencies
4. Verify TypeScript is configured with strict mode in tsconfig.json
5. Clean up default Vite boilerplate (remove unnecessary files like App.css assets)
6. Test that 'npm run dev' starts successfully
7. Test that 'npm run build' completes without errors
8. Initialize git repository with 'git init'
9. Create initial .gitignore if not present (node_modules, dist, .env)
10. Commit the initial scaffold: 'git add . && git commit -m "Initial Vite + React + TypeScript setup"'

steps.title: Define TypeScript types and localStorage utilities
steps.description:
Create the type definitions and localStorage helper functions. Tasks:
1. Create src/types.ts with Note interface (id: string, title: string, body: string, createdAt: number)
2. Create src/utils/storage.ts with functions:
   - loadNotes(): Note[] - loads notes from localStorage, handles JSON parse errors
   - saveNotes(notes: Note[]): void - saves notes to localStorage
   - STORAGE_KEY constant = 'react-notes-app'
3. Add error handling for localStorage (try/catch blocks)
4. Add type guards to ensure loaded data matches Note[] type
5. Test that TypeScript compiles without errors: 'npm run build'
6. Commit changes: 'git add . && git commit -m "Add TypeScript types and localStorage utilities"'

steps.title: Implement core note components
steps.description:
Build the React components for notes functionality. Tasks:
1. Create src/components/NoteForm.tsx - form with title and body inputs, onSubmit handler
2. Create src/components/NoteList.tsx - displays array of notes, passes delete handler
3. Create src/components/NoteItem.tsx - individual note display with delete button
4. Update src/App.tsx:
   - Import Note type and storage utilities
   - useState for notes array
   - useEffect to load notes from localStorage on mount
   - useEffect to save notes to localStorage when notes change
   - handleAddNote function (generates UUID, timestamp, updates state)
   - handleDeleteNote function (filters by id, updates state)
   - Render NoteForm and NoteList with appropriate props
5. Ensure all components are properly typed with TypeScript
6. Test compilation: 'npm run build'
7. Commit: 'git add . && git commit -m "Implement note CRUD components"'

steps.title: Add styling and polish UI
steps.description:
Apply minimal, clean CSS styling to the app. Tasks:
1. Create src/App.css or use inline styles for:
   - Container layout (centered, max-width, padding)
   - Note list (card-style items, spacing)
   - Note form (input fields, submit button styling)
   - Delete buttons (positioned, colored)
   - Typography (readable fonts, sizes, line-height)
2. Ensure responsive design (works on mobile and desktop)
3. Add hover states for interactive elements
4. Test the UI in the browser: 'npm run dev'
5. Verify all CRUD operations work:
   - Create new notes
   - View notes in the list
   - Delete notes
   - Refresh browser and verify persistence
6. Commit: 'git add . && git commit -m "Add minimal styling and UI polish"'

steps.title: Validate and finalize
steps.description:
Final validation and cleanup to meet definition of done. Tasks:
1. Run 'npm run build' and verify it completes without errors
2. Run 'npm run dev' and verify dev server starts successfully
3. Manually test all functionality:
   - Create multiple notes with different titles and bodies
   - Verify notes appear in the list
   - Delete notes and verify they're removed
   - Refresh browser and verify notes persist from localStorage
   - Test edge cases (empty fields, long content)
4. Verify TypeScript strict mode is enabled in tsconfig.json
5. Check that there are no TypeScript errors: 'npx tsc --noEmit'
6. Run 'git status' to ensure all changes are committed
7. If any uncommitted changes, commit them: 'git add . && git commit -m "Final cleanup and validation"'
8. Verify clean git status: 'git status' should show 'working tree clean'
9. Document any known limitations or future improvements in a comment
10. Confirm all Definition of Done checkboxes are met
